# A P0 task and a P2 task write the same file and both are ready at once. The swarm lands the P0 task first, the P2 task conflicts, and the merge task takes the base, so the P0 content stays.
isolate
swarmfakes

exec obeeswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
exec obeeswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# One merge call of the agent settled the conflict, and both pull requests landed.
grep -count=1 '^resolve ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log

# The file holds the content of the P0 task (the second item), not the P2 task (the first).
exec git --git-dir=remote.git show main:a.txt
stdout 'swarm-3'
! stdout 'swarm-2'

-- backlog.txt --
P2	late	a.txt
P0	first	a.txt
